O.outcome_detail: blinded academic marker score for digital health solution design

cells.quote: AI-generated responses showed progressive improvements with structured prompting and rubric integration, most notably in GPT-4 (V3), which scored 69% compared to 56% for GPT-4 (V1; Table 3).

O.outcome_detail: blinded academic marker score for digital health solution design

cells.quote: Notably, the use of the more advanced o1 model (V4) did not improve performance over GPT-4 (V3), scoring only 63%, and continued to exhibit generic recommendations and limited tailoring to the scenario.

O.outcome_detail: blinded academic marker score for digital health business case

cells.quote: The business case results similarly report o1 Preview V4 at 64% below GPT-4 V2 at 68%.
cells.note: The quoted sentence is from the wiki entry because the supplied study text is truncated before the detailed business case result.
